summary: Retest of the large-file-upload/502 bug fix. 14 backend tests passed (added a fix for a genuine test-suite race between the storage-outage test and the multipart-upload tests, plus one new backend test for the R2/Whisper-not-swapped criterion) + 5 browser checks re-ran and passed. No app bugs found.
action_items: Fixed a test-infrastructure race (not an app bug): test_tscheck_storage_failure_returns_424.py stops/starts the shared 'localstoragestub' supervisor program while test_tscheck_large_file_multipart_upload.py's tests run concurrently under xdist -n2/--dist loadscope, causing large-file uploads/GETs to intermittently hit the stub mid-outage (424/500). Added a cross-process filelock (tests/conftest.py: storage_stub_lock fixture) that both files now acquire around their storage-touching critical sections. Full suite is deterministic across 3 consecutive runs after the fix.

checks.criterion: REPORTED BUG FIXED: large-file upload no longer 502s (>32MB triggers boto3 multipart with explicit TransferConfig)
checks.name: test_large_file_upload_returns_201_with_correct_size_and_defers_transcription
checks.evidence: POST /api/projects with /tmp/big-narration.wav (48MB) -> 201; audio.object_key startswith audio/<id>/; audio.size_bytes == 50540804 (within 2000-byte tolerance); transcription.status was 'pending'/'processing' at response time, proving upload doesn't block on transcription.

checks.criterion: REPORTED BUG FIXED: large-file upload works via the browser UI too (small fixture for speed)
checks.name: upload-large-file-via-public-url
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check against the public URL: selecting /tmp/speech23.wav via upload-file-input navigated to /projects/<uuid> with editor-page rendered. Screenshot: upload-large-file-via-public-url-big-file-editor-loaded.png.

checks.criterion: Multipart round-trip is byte-exact, not truncated
checks.name: test_large_file_streams_intact_full_and_ranged
checks.evidence: GET /api/projects/{id}/audio for the 48MB project -> 200, content-length == audio.size_bytes (50540804); Range bytes=0-999 -> 206 with content-range header and exactly 1000 bytes returned.

checks.criterion: Large-file transcription is real and timeline-correct (chunk offsets applied)
checks.name: test_large_file_transcription_completes_with_timeline_correct_segments
checks.evidence: Polled GET /api/projects/{id} until transcription.status == 'ready' (within the 180s budget); GET /api/projects/{id}/transcript returned len(segments) > 50 (target ~221), proving Whisper chunking + reassembly worked for the ~26min file.

checks.criterion: A storage failure shows the ACTUAL reason (424 + JSON detail), not a generic gateway error, and recovers
checks.name: test_storage_down_returns_424_with_actionable_detail_then_recovers
checks.evidence: With localstoragestub stopped: POST /api/projects -> 424, content-type application/json, detail contains 'object storage' and 'r2_endpoint_url'/'r2_account_id'. After restarting the stub (+3s settle): a following upload -> 201.

checks.criterion: Small-file path and the editor timeline still work (no regression) — API
checks.name: test_upload_creates_project_with_stored_audio / test_audio_stream_supports_full_and_range_requests
checks.evidence: POST /api/projects with /tmp/speech23.wav -> 201, duration_seconds in [20,27]; GET .../audio -> 200 full body; Range GET -> 206 with content-range and exactly 1000 bytes.

checks.criterion: Small-file path and the editor timeline still work (no regression) — UI
checks.name: transcript-segments-display-and-seek
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: transcription-status-badge reached 'transcript ready'; transcript-list > transcript-segment-0 visible with timestamp+text; same segment rendered in timeline-lane-transcript; click seeked the audio.

checks.criterion: Editor shows all timeline lanes and transport controls work (no regression)
checks.name: timeline-lanes-scrub-and-zoom / audio-playback-controls-timecode
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted checks: timeline-ruler, timeline-lane-transcript, timeline-lane-audio, timeline-waveform, timeline-playhead all visible; scrub + zoom-in/out/fit worked with lanes intact. transport-play-button click advanced timecode-readout off 00:00:00:00, second click paused it.

checks.criterion: R2 and real Whisper transcription were not swapped out for mocks/local fallback
checks.name: test_system_status_reports_r2_and_whisper / test_storage_module_has_no_local_disk_fallback / test_transcription_module_is_not_mocked
checks.evidence: GET /api/system/status -> storage.provider == 'cloudflare_r2', storage.configured == true, transcription.configured == true, transcription.model == 'whisper-1'. Static read of lib/storage.py confirms boto3 usage with no disk-fallback markers; services/transcription.py references 'whisper-1' with no mock/stub markers.
